title: The slow lane
goal: out reads (((a XOR b) XOR c) AND a) OR b, settled within 3 ns. Built as it is written it takes 4, since every gate costs a nanosecond: the same answer must come through fewer gates in a row.
hint: simplify before you build. Whenever b is 1, out is 1; work out what out needs the rest of the time.
